name: Storyboarder
description: Storyboarder's recovered Electron updater checks for updates with automatic downloading disabled, prompts the user, downloads after confirmation, and schedules quitAndInstall. Its build metadata names a Windows publisher and an afterSign notarization hook; application-source evidence for sha512 enforcement and released artifact signing remains unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; electron-updater internals, generated metadata, platform signing output, and notarization results were not independently audited.
